rules.when: authority and infraction_date match one official range
rules.action: Return preliminary match with source and range.

rules.when: authority and date match multiple ranges
rules.action: Return every match; never collapse distinct causes.
State no matrix match; do not infer legality or absence of other defenses.
Require individualized review; do not promise reimbursement.

rules.when: collection, payment order, embargo or judicial proceeding
rules.action: Block automatic action and route to professional review.
Prioritize professional review; the checker does not suspend terms.
Block persistence of unverified data and provide security warning.
Require identity, email and separate data-processing consent.
Create new version; preserve historical results and source snapshot.

rules.when: match exists but device is unknown
rules.action: Request location/device and clarify that authority-date match is insufficient for final relief.
Require proof of a firm Supertransporte decision and individual applicability.
